thesis: Hold. Sizing book is about $850 cash and one VTI lot (~$150). Nothing in this open pack is specific enough to size a speculative long. Carnival's Item 2.02 8-K (13:16Z) is results with no figures, so direction is unknown. Novo's second licensing deal (09:45Z) names no partner, asset, or terms, and the same-morning GLP-1 vision piece is a soft offset, not a trade. TSMC reportedly eyeing a second U.S. site is an unconfirmed rumor. MongoDB's CEO exit to Meta, Micron's pre-print commentary, and the Nvidia valuation column are prior-session items. Wilson's large-cap-quality remark is not a reason to add or sell VTI. WTI and USO are down about 2.4-3% with no causal headline, so I will not buy USO or infer an airline or cruise trade. Delisting filings, unregistered equity sales, header-only 8-Ks, and House PTRs that name no symbols are not entries.
